svg.text: Hindsight does not just know more — it revises the feasible state
Final-vintage MDO/MDB versus the envelope publicly observable 60 minutes before delivery, per settlement period, July 2026 panel.
989 periods where the supporting envelope was published only after the decision cutoff
1,991 periods where the final vintage withdrew opportunity the public envelope had supported
The pooled net, £1.3m, conceals both flows. Either direction grades a historical decision against a revised information set.
